title: Kyckr MCP Values
description: Values for the Kyckr MCP Helm chart. A Python FastMCP server on the base chart. Exposure uses base chart Gateway API routes (no custom Ingress).

mcpConfig.description: Non-secret settings, mapped to environment variables. publicBaseUrl, zitadel.baseUrl and kyckr.apiUrl are mandatory. The secrets come from a Secret through extraEnvSecrets or envVars (see README).

publicBaseUrl.description: MCP_BASE_URL: the public https origin. Mandatory: the overlay sets it. Must match routes.hostname.

baseUrl.description: ZITADEL_BASE_URL: the Zitadel issuer. Mandatory: the overlay sets it. Its host gets Cilium egress on port 443, so the URL is https without a port.

orgId.description: ZITADEL_ORG_ID: optional, restricts sign-in to one organisation.

apiUrl.description: UPSTREAM_API_URL. Mandatory, with no default: https://api.kyckr.com/v2 is production, https://test-api.kyckr.com/v2 is test. Its host gets Cilium egress on port 443, so the URL is https without a port.

timeoutSeconds.description: UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT_SECONDS: how long one request to Kyckr may take.

defaultCustomerReference.description: UPSTREAM_DEFAULT_CUSTOMER_REFERENCE: sent to Kyckr for usage reconciliation when a call names none.

defaultContactEmail.description: UPSTREAM_DEFAULT_CONTACT_EMAIL: the contact on a document order when a call names none.

rateLimit.description: Tool calls per signed-in user, counted per replica: N replicas allow N times toolCallsPerWindow.

toolCallsPerWindow.description: MCP_RATE_LIMIT_TOOL_CALLS_PER_WINDOW: tool calls one user may make in a window, on one replica.

windowSeconds.description: MCP_RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_SECONDS: the length of the window.
